features.name: Compact dark rectangular upper with curved trigger guard and raked grip as labeled illustration
Special model-specific silencer is optional, not baseline equipment

Assigned sole final reviewer inspected actual raw detailed and manually smoothed clay references, native foreground/masks, both2048 masks, detailed/clay teal previews and paired overlay. Source form follows labeled Arsenal LightFire70 primary art as recorded in detail eligibility. Major silhouette/proportions, low top assemblies, upper/frame/base boundaries, large side-panel boundaries, raised major controls, thin trigger/guard and both actual guard clearances retained. Serrations, grip/guard ribs, stippling, microtexture and small fastener recesses are filled; three authorized annuli removed with bounded conventional raster fills. Host surfaces are visibly continuous at normal reference size; no separate circular recesses remain. Outside patch pixels unchanged0; original RGB mode unchanged, no source alpha altered, and original-clay foreground classification identical before/after edits. Core detailed alpha reused unchanged. One isolated clay AA pixel at(776,539) excluded beside the lower trigger junction; not a separate part. Thin natural edge transitions follow the silhouette, no broad halo/clipping/detached parts. No independent warp or forced mask transfer. Dark detailed finish/fine appearance are artistic interpretations of monochrome source. Reference-only approval, no geometry/fitting/client/production approval.
